_comment: Declare the MCP servers this project uses. Delete the ones you don't need and add your own. The filename MUST be `.mcp.json` (dotfile) and the root key MUST be `mcpServers` — that is the project-scoped format AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) looks for; anything else is silently ignored. NEVER hardcode API keys or tokens here: this file is committed to git. Use ${ENV_VAR} expansion and export the value in your shell, as in the _example_with_secret entry below (delete it).
